reviews.title: Good value and still going strong
reviews.comment: I've used this for a few years now and it keeps my Intel 13500 CPU running quite cool. Yeah, it's not a powerhouse CPU that needs an AIO cooler, but I was going for aesthetic and quiet. It achieves that for me without breaking the bank on cost.
reviews.author: avatarALIVE

reviews.title: Works great easy install and very quiet.
reviews.comment: Works absolutely wonderful. I didn’t have a three pin for the ARGb on my board so I just bought a argb&pwm  hub and it worked great with all the hook ups and the cooler as well. Absolutely silent and not a single noise from the fans either and it dropped my CPU heat down by at least 10° 12° so far.
reviews.author: GLR PROPHET1

reviews.title: For under $60 this is an excellent option
reviews.comment: 9800x3d properly overclocked and this thing keeps it safe! Value for money is definite. The infinity look is cool, got my gpu and case lights to a slight blue tint off white to make it match up and it looks clean. Great performing cooler for the money no doubt!
reviews.author: MrBigMittens

reviews.title: Very quiet and looks amazing also runs amazing
reviews.comment: Very good cooler all though since its my first time putting an aio on it took almosg 6 hours of figuring out the wires 😭 but its very quiet and i idle at 35° c and around 60-65 under load (i5 10400f)
reviews.author: Booga ooga

reviews.title: get thermal paste before you install
reviews.comment: the product it self is  good. it's just the thermal  paste that isn't good. i've bought two and had to buy separate paste both times.
